updates.headline: Opening night: two road comebacks, star overs went cold

games.label: BOS @ DET — Pistons 121, Celtics 113
games.result: DK close BOS -1.5, total 220.5 → DET covered outright, total went OVER (234)
notes: Boston led 72-50 early in the 3rd; Detroit pulled off the largest opening-day comeback in NBA history.
Paul George scored 38 in his Celtics debut (7-12 from three, 5 steals).
Jayson Tatum shot 6-23 (0-7 from three) for 13 points and 11 assists, in his first full season back from the May 2025 Achilles tear.
Javonte Green didn't play in the first half, then scored 19 (5-8 from three). Duren had 22 and 9, Duncan Robinson 21 (5-9 from three), Cade 22 points and 8 assists, Ausar Thompson 11 and 11.

games.label: PHI @ NY — 76ers 106, Knicks 100
games.result: DK close NY -4.5, total 231.5 → PHI won outright, total went UNDER (206)
notes: It was the Knicks' banner and ring night, and they shot 37% from the field and 33% from three. Brunson went 6-19 for 21.
Maxey scored 28. Jaylen Brown had 19, 8 and 6 in his 76ers debut. LeBron had 14, 9 and 7 to open his 24th season. Embiid had 13, 11 and 6 with 3 blocks.
PHI's bench beat the Knicks' focus on the stars: Anfernee Simons hit 3 threes and Caldwell-Pope 2. Mikal Bridges scored 4; OG Anunoby went 1-9 from three with 0 assists.

record: 25-leg ticket ($0.11 to win $950k): lost. 11 legs won, 6 lost, 8 still pending in OKC @ SA. Losing legs: Edgecombe PRA 19.5 (14), LeBron 15.5 pts (14), Embiid 25.5 pts+ast (19), Anunoby 1.5 stl (1), Queta 7.5 reb (4), Cade 10+ ast (8).
Top single picks: 2-4 with 6 pending. Lost: Collins over 0.5 threes (0), Anunoby over 1.5 ast (0), Jaylen Brown over 20.5 pts (19), Edgecombe over 11.5 pts (9).
One pick per game: lost (Collins over 0.5 threes missed; Simons over 1.5 threes hit).
Single-game sets: 0 of 18 settled tickets cashed. The individual legs went 17-13 (57%), but a 6-leg ticket needs every leg, and many missed by just 1 or 2 legs.
App board: NBA props 34-23-2, +7.95u, almost all unders. The #1 featured picks went 6-1-1. Team picks: Under 232.5 in PHI-NY won; Boston ML -122 lost after leading by 22.
lessons: One night is a small sample. Treat these as things to watch, not rule changes.

Stars in new-team debuts (Embiid, LeBron, Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown) went under their scoring lines: a new-look roster spreads the shots around. Lean away from star scoring overs on teams with big roster changes until a few games show the new usage.
Opening-night shooting was cold (Knicks 37%, Tatum 0-7 from three). Board unders went 32-21-2, while overs carried most of the parlay damage.

Heavy-juice 'at least one' props (Collins over 0.5 threes at -182, Ausar over 1.5 steals at -194) sank several set tickets each. When one leg is on 5 tickets, its miss costs 5 tickets: spread those legs across fewer tickets.
A 6-leg set built from ~60% legs only hits about 5% of the time, so expect long losing streaks. Keep stakes tiny.
Calibration so far: ticket legs hit 65% (11-6) vs 51% predicted; top picks hit 33% (2-4) vs ~59% predicted. Too early to recalibrate; the tracker will show it over the next week.
